en: Black‑and‑white view of a small European town square or wide street. On the left is a three‑storey historicist building with balconies and a sign reading "Gasthaus zum Sachsen Hof". On the right is another ornate building with a corner tower and clock; its facade bears the words "Radfahrer Station" and "Restaurant, Amtshof". In the distance are smaller houses and a lightly cobbled street with a few pedestrians and a cart. The scene appears late 19th or early 20th century.
